name: com.jeromehandywash/site
title: Jerome Handy Wash
description: Read-only Jerome Handy Wash machines, prices, hours, payment methods, FAQ and contact links.

tools.name: get_cycle_times
tools.description: Published quick, normal and heavy wash cycle times, typical drying time and dryer minutes purchased at each starting price and per extra quarter, in English or Spanish. These are site facts, not live machine timers or a drying guarantee.

language.description: Which language of the site to quote: "en" (default) or "es" (the Spanish pages, under /es/).

tools.name: get_machines
tools.description: Every washer and dryer size at Jerome Handy Wash as the pricing page lists it: size, how many there are, the price and the notes on each card, plus the services page's machine description and its real cycle times. All Speed Queen. Counts are machines on site, not which are free right now (no tool knows that).

language.description: Which language of the site to quote: "en" (default) or "es" (the Spanish pages, under /es/).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: The pricing page: each washer and dryer price exactly as printed, what a typical wash and dry costs, vending prices, the 25 cent Scan to Pay surcharge note and the commercial or bulk note. Returns published prices without calculating custom totals.

language.description: Which language of the site to quote: "en" (default) or "es" (the Spanish pages, under /es/).

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: How you can pay at Jerome Handy Wash, as the pricing page lists it (coins, the change machine and the bills it takes, the ATM, cards, the Speed Queen app, Scan to Pay wallets), the surcharge note, the Speed Queen app location code and what the app does. Payment happens at the machine; nothing here takes one.

language.description: Which language of the site to quote: "en" (default) or "es" (the Spanish pages, under /es/).

tools.name: get_location_hours
tools.description: Where Jerome Handy Wash is and when it is open, from the contact page: address, hours, phone, email, mailing address and languages as listed, the page's own opening lines, the map and directions links, and the coordinates and opening hours from the page's structured data.

language.description: Which language of the site to quote: "en" (default) or "es" (the Spanish pages, under /es/).

tools.name: get_amenities
tools.description: What the store offers, from the services page: its feature cards, the full amenities list, what the space is like (parking, cameras, folding tables, benches, restroom, unattended), the softened water and the free Wi-Fi availability, with a services-page link for connection details.

language.description: Which language of the site to quote: "en" (default) or "es" (the Spanish pages, under /es/).

tools.name: how_to_report_machine_issue
tools.description: Read-only: returns the published way to report a machine or payment problem (a machine that took money, stopped mid cycle or will not open), in English or Spanish: what to include, the email and phone, the response and refund lines as published, and the report page. It does NOT file, send or store a report.

language.description: Which language of the site to quote: "en" (default) or "es" (the Spanish pages, under /es/).

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: The site's FAQ answers (hours, prices, machines, payment, ATM, WiFi, what to do when something goes wrong). Take A Load Off answers identify the separate wash-and-fold partner and link to its own site, without its prices, turnaround or phone. Returns up to five answers by default, with or without a query. The language value "es" selects the Spanish FAQ.

query.description: Nonblank words to look for, e.g. "ATM" or "king comforter"; without a query, FAQ answers are listed.

language.description: Which language of the site to quote: "en" (default) or "es" (the Spanish pages, under /es/).

limit.description: At most this many answers (default 5, maximum 10). The source page contains the full FAQ.

tools.name: get_contact_form_link
tools.description: A link that opens the site's contact form with the reason (topic), the machine number and the message already filled in, in English or Spanish. It only builds the link and sends nothing. There are no separate name, email or phone inputs. Recognizable email addresses and phone numbers in machine or message text are rejected. Message text is included in the URL. The person checks the form, adds their own name and email, and presses Send message.

topic.description: The reason, one of the form's own values: general (a question), machine (a broken machine), payment (a payment or refund problem), bulk (commercial or bulk pricing), other.

machine.description: The machine number, if it applies.

message.description: The message, in the person's own words.

language.description: Which language of the site to quote: "en" (default) or "es" (the Spanish pages, under /es/).

examples.message: Washer 12 took my money and did not start
